rationale: The agent did not follow key policy requirements. There is no evidence of proper user authentication beyond looking up by email. The agent appears to have executed write actions without prior user confirmation: it likely modified a pending order item (exchange request) and explicitly updated the default shipping address, then announced the change, all without first confirming with the user. The final response only confirms the address update and provides no confirmation or outcome details for the requested exchange (color red, half-zip), so the user’s request was not fully completed. Additionally, the agent selected a specific DC address from past orders without validating that it was the intended one. These issues violate “confirm every order-changing action before taking it” and “give correct final information,” so the interaction fails the pass bar.
